title: Vegetarian Algerian Tagine
description: A hearty, flavorful vegetarian tagine made with algerian spices, oozy goodness, and tender vegetables.

ingredients.name: Chicken Broth
ingredients.notes: Vegetarian broth alternative: Carrot and celery broth

ingredients.name: Algerian spice blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most spice stores or online

instructions: Heat the broth in a large, heavy pot over medium heat.
Add the Algerian spice blend and stir to combine.
Add the onion, carrots, zucchini, and bell pepper. Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional 2 minutes, until fragrant.
Stir in the oozy and honey (if using).
Simmer the tagine for 10-15 minutes, until the flavors have melded together.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
